title: Dual Impact
description: A 3D boxing sparring duel in your browser: throw jabs, crosses, hooks and uppercuts as the black fighter against an automated red robot, with bone-bound hit anchors, impact sparks and punch sounds.

defaultCaptions.x: Step into the ring in Dual Impact: jab, hook and uppercut a red robot boxer in 3D, right in the browser.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Dual Impact is a browser 3D boxing duel. Control the black fighter, trade punches with an automated red robot, and feel every hit with sparks and punch sounds.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Made a small 3D boxing sparring game: you control the black fighter, a robot controls the red one, and every fist-to-bone-anchor contact triggers a hit effect.
defaultCaptions.discord: Dual Impact: a quick 3D boxing duel against a robot opponent. Jab, cross, hook, uppercut.
